messages.subject: Re: BioGeoBEARS error
parts:
On Sat, Jun 3, 2017 at 6:38 AM, Itanna Oliveira Fernandes <itanna.f...@gmail.com> wrote:
Dear Nick,

I am trying to run the BioGeoBEARS and in my very first try I got the following error:
Error in matrix(data = NA, nrow = ntips, ncol = nareas) : 
  invalid 'nrow' value (too large or NA)
I was running RStudio and my input were a newick tree (from FBD model) and txt doc with the species from the FBD model and their respective zoogeographic areas.
The matrix has 234 taxa (4.258bp) and some of those have more than one individual of the same species (i.e. Anochetus mayri I88, Anochetus mayri I01, ...).
I am totally new using R, as well, in systematic. So, could you please help me to figure this out? 
Best regards, 

Itanna


Itanna Oliveira Fernandes
Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas da Amazônia - INPA 
Coordenação em Biodiversidade CBio/Entomologia
Av: André Araújo, 2936. Petrópolis.
Manaus - AM. Brasil, 69067-375.

http://fauna.jbrj.gov.br/fauna/faunadobrasil/2617
http://lattes.cnpq.br/5126000463150115


 

Hi -- several issues here:

1a. Your geog file:

=============
T N F I A P
Euponera_rovana_I130_0.0 0 0 1 1 1 0
Simopelta_jeckylli_I18_0.0 1 0 0 0 0 0
Brachyponera_sennarensis_I132_0.0 0 0 1 1 0 0
Cryptopone_butteli_I41_0.0 0 0 0 1 1 0
Dinoponera_quadriceps_I23_0.0 1 0 0 0 0 0
Neoponera_villosa_I16_0.0 1 1 0 0 0 0
[...]
=============


1b. Correct geog file:
=============
233 6 (T N F I A P) Euponera_rovana_I130_0.0 001110 Simopelta_jeckylli_I18_0.0 100000 Brachyponera_sennarensis_I132_0.0 001100 Cryptopone_butteli_I41_0.0 000110 Dinoponera_quadriceps_I23_0.0 100000 Neoponera_villosa_I16_0.0 110000
[...]
=============

See example files, and advice on text editors, here:
http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeobears#files


2. Your newick file has apostrophe characters in it (').  This means they don't match the species names in the geog file. I deleted them.  The example script says:

#######################################################
# Phylogeny file
# Notes: 
# 1. Must be binary/bifurcating: no polytomies
# 2. No negative branchlengths (e.g. BEAST MCC consensus trees sometimes have negative branchlengths)


3. The newick file has 3 negative branchlengths. I fixed this with impose_min_brlen().  This is addressed here:

http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeobears-mistakes-to-avoid#short_branches

http://phylo.wikidot.com/testing-for-fixing-common-tree-file-problems-in-biogeobears
(search on "impose_min_brlen")


Sending fixed files off-list, they run fine after the fixes...

Cheers, Nick
